findings.title: Transfer server without CloudWatch logging
findings.description: Without a logging_role the server emits no CloudWatch logs, leaving file-transfer activity invisible to detection. Attach a logging_role with CloudWatch permissions.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.
